0.original: Swozblaet, the master merchant of Hawkers' Alley, wants you to look into current market prices.

1.original: Swozblaet has bid you pose as a customer and glance over the wares being sold by Iron Thunder, Kyokyoroon, and Syneyhil. Strike up a conversation with the three merchants, and surreptitiously record the prices of their goods.

2.original: You have completed your survey of market prices. Deliver the price list to Baensyng on West Hawkers' Alley.

3.original: You have delivered your report to Baensyng. According to the prices you recorded, the markets seem free of any shady dealings for another day.

27.original: Deliver the price list to Baensyng.

48.original: You, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>─adventurer. I have work for you. I would have you pose as a customer and survey the market's current prices.

49.original: Surely I did not see you balk at so simple a task? All you need do is strike up a conversation with the shop owners, and glance over their wares.

50.original: There are three merchants that interest me: Iron Thunder, Kyokyoroon, and Syneyhil.

51.original: Write down all you see on this price list, and hand it to Baensyng on West Hawkers' Alley. He shall reward you for your service.

53.original: Well met, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>! Cast your peepers over these beauties! Not a spot of rust to be found! Every piece fresh from the forges of Naldiq & Vymelli's!

54.original: Kyokyoroon welcomes well-come customer! Kyokyoroon loves his lovely trade! Kyokyoroon's goods are goodly made!

55.original: A fine <hex:020839E3E90C0DFF1B020817E3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF086D6F726E696E6703FF17020813E3E90C12FF04646179FF086576656E696E670303> to you, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. What can I interest you in t─ Why, you seem interested in most everything, don't you? Is this another one of those investigations!? Well, I have nothing to hide!

56.original: Yer the one what made a list for Swozblaet? Let's 'ave it, then.

57.original: Mmm, nothin' wrong with the markets, far as I can tell.

58.original: Ye ofttimes get pirates sellin' stolen goods at cutthroat prices, an' that drives the numbers down right across 'Awkers' Alley. Thanks to these reports, though, we can tell at a glance when shady dealin's are takin' place. Good work, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>.
